reason: GameState gains unsettled_entry_batch_events (battlefield-entry events of an entering instruction still suspended on a co-entrant's prompt, held unmatched until the instruction completes) and instruction_boundary_marks (the zone-change ledger length at each instruction boundary and between the occurrences of a counted repeat, which cuts the ledger into the intervals treated as simultaneous entry events). A reader without them drops the held entries on restore, so those entries are never checked for enters triggers; a restore now refuses marks outside the ledger and a held-entry list that repeats an entry or holds anything but this turn's ledger-backed battlefield entries. A phase trigger's stack ability also carries SpellContext.phase_turn_player (the turn player its chain was bound to); a reader without it treats the binding as a player-scope seat leg and observes that trigger's entries late, as before.
